notes: Drive Health now tells the truth. If a drive doesn't report SMART (common for USB docks/enclosures) it shows 'Unknown' and asks you to run a Surface test, instead of a misleading 100%. Surface-scan results (slow or unreadable regions) now feed straight into the Health and Performance verdict, with a plain-English explanation - so a drive with 1400 ms slow spots reads as Failing, not Healthy.
